product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos into interactive 3D models of homes and buildings so construction professionals, insurance experts, and homeowners can measure, design, and scope projects.

pricing_page.notes: The page lists plans, including a custom-priced business plan.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, customer and marketing content, not at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public API portal links to multiple guides and reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open posting is for Principal Agentic AI Engineer.

model_provider.value: Hover says its custom generative AI works with publicly accessible pretrained technologies including Stable Diffusion, Realistic Vision, Metric3D, OneFormer, MLSD, and NormalBAE; it does not name a provider.

last_funding.notes: The latest listed financing is a completed debt deal dated February 19, 2026.
